scope: Long-running manager goal, including harness development and experiment coordination; not a per-task API billing vector. Do not add to or compare directly with the CLI token accounting; attribution and counter definitions differ.

goal.objective:
First, build and validate the best reliable OpenCode-derived harness A3B can use, preserving useful tools and providing deterministic debugging, sound budgets and reliable session continuity. Then rerun the confounded real-world cases and compare
  thinking on versus off under matched conditions, recording token usage and outcomes. Finally, compare A3B working independently or with measured guidance against main-only execution, treating local tokens as free and assessing main-model effort,
  elapsed time and accepted results.
